task: FV2-020 — Flutter Design V2 connected voice dock presentation parity
summary: Aligned Flutter's connected voice dock with the latest web presentation: headset marker, connected status copy, room participant context, and a visually hidden unknown-quality placeholder that remains available to assistive technology. Voice and LiveKit behavior were not changed.

checks.name: Focused connected dock state, semantics and participant count tests
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'voice dock announces reconnect and deafen transition states' && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'macOS shows an unsubscribed published screen and opens it' && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'keeps voice controls in a compact bottom dock on Android'
checks.observation: Covers desktop connected copy/headset/participant context, semantic quality description with no visible unknown indicator, remote participant count, and compact Android dock spacing and controls.

checks.name: Changed-file analyzer
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && dart analyze lib/src/screens/workspace_screen.dart test/workspace_screen_test.dart

checks.name: Android signed release build
checks.artifact: 1.0.28+2051; 115.4 MB; SHA-256 dd7ce7276cec475cfbe9f8beb1d86ef2f08de88c6e55798c8078e987a9cfd241; artifact remains in ignored build output and was not added to Git.

checks.name: Android API 35 emulator visual acceptance
checks.command: adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk; launch ru.boohtacord.app/.MainActivity; inspect voice dock in Voice
checks.observation: Updated the installed signed 1.0.28+2050 in place without clearing app data. At 1080x2400 the connected dock showed the green headset, 'Голос подключён', 'Voice · 3 участника' and live 9 ms RTT. Selection auto-joined Voice; the microphone was muted immediately, confirmed by accessibility label 'Включить микрофон', then the temporary voice session was left. Screenshot remains in /private/tmp/boohtacord-voice-dock-v2051-muted.png.

checks.name: macOS current-source hot reload visual acceptance
checks.observation: Attach waited 14 seconds for a Flutter VM service and was stopped. The already-running Mac window still showed the older connected copy; it was not restarted, to avoid another Keychain prompt.

checks.name: macOS Debug build
checks.observation: The currently open app appears to use the standard Debug app bundle path. Building there could replace files under the live process, so the build was skipped; Flutter does not expose --build-dir for this target.

checks.name: Spec traceability after backlog update
checks.observation: PowerShell Core is not installed on this macOS host. The task references existing approved UI and voice requirements; no contracts changed.

limitations: FV2-020 remains open until the current source is visually reviewed on the already-running Mac client without a restart, or the user permits a restart after the app can be safely relaunched.
